programs.code: learn("shelter"); move("east", 1); pickup("wood"); move("east", 2); move("north", 1); pickup("stone"); wait(8);
programs.summary: Exercise the required learning diagnostic, collect both visible items, and remain safely at 22°C for a 15-round program.
Exercise the required learning diagnostic, collect the nearby berry, and remain safely idle in mild conditions for a 15-round program.
Exercise the required learning diagnostic, collect the nearby crystal, then wait in safe temperatures for a 15-round program.
Remain safely in place for 15 rounds at 22°C, conserving full health while satiety remains well above the damage threshold.
Remain safely idle for 15 rounds at 22°C. Satiety will stay well above the damage threshold, preserving full health.
Remain in the safe 22°C conditions for 15 rounds, conserving full health while satiety stays comfortably above the damage threshold.
Stay in place for 15 rounds at a safe 22°C. Satiety will decrease to 77.5, remaining safely above the damage threshold, with health preserved at 100.
Wait safely for 15 rounds at 22°C, preserving full health while satiety decreases to 77.5.
Stay in safe 22°C conditions for 15 rounds. Satiety will fall to 77.5, with health remaining at 100 and no cold or heat exposure.
Remain at a safe 22°C for the final 15 rounds. Satiety will fall to 70, with no cold, heat, or starvation damage; health will remain at 100.
Remain safely at 22°C for the final 15 rounds, finishing with full health, no exposure, and 70 satiety.
Remain in safe 22°C conditions through the final 15 rounds. Satiety will reach 70, while health stays at 100 with no cold or heat exposure.
